gloss: from the start; from the very beginning

definitions.gloss: from the start; from the very beginning
definitions.explanation: A set phrase meaning from the beginning of something, often emphasizing that a condition or situation has been true from the outset, or used to indicate starting over from the beginning.

examples.japanese: {最初|さいしょ}から⟦やり{直|なお}す→やり直す：03172_yarinaosu⟧。
examples.english: To start over from the beginning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{最初|さいしょ}から⟦{賛成|さんせい}→賛成：02829_sansei⟧でした。
examples.english: I was in favor of it from the very start.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{最初|さいしょ}から⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦つもり→つもり：01152_tsumori⟧だったらしい。
examples.english: It seems he had that intention from the very beginning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{間違|まちが}えた→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{最初|さいしょ}から⟦{書|か}き{直|なお}さ→書き直す：04597_kakinaosu⟧⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: I made a mistake, so I have to rewrite it from the beginning.

notes:
A set phrase combining ⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧ (the beginning, first) + ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ (from). Used to indicate that something has been true since the very beginning, or that an action is being restarted from the beginning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最初|さいしょ}から⟦やり{直|なお}す→やり直す：03172_yarinaosu⟧: to start over from the beginning
- {最初|さいしょ}から⟦{知|し}っていた→知る：00458_shiru⟧: to have known from the start
- {最初|さいしょ}から⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧: impossible from the start
- {最初|さいしょ}から⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦つもり→つもり：01152_tsumori⟧: to have intended it from the beginning
- {最初|さいしょ}から⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: from beginning to end

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{初|はじ}め→初め：02931_hajime⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from the beginning — nearly synonymous; slightly more casual/spoken
- ⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from scratch — emphasizes starting over completely, often without relying on any previous work
- ⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: at first; initially — indicates a point in time, not a continuous state

USAGE:
Often used emotionally to express that something was obvious or decided early on, as in {最初|さいしょ}からそう⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧ ("You should have said that from the start!"). When paired with verbs like ⟦やり{直|なお}す→やり直す：03172_yarinaosu⟧, it means to redo from scratch.
